Rivian Recalls Nearly 100,000 Vehicles Over Camera Software Issue

Rivian announced a recall of almost 99,000 vehicles, with another source reporting about 100,700 vehicles, due to a rearview camera display software problem. The recall covers the affected models, but no further details on corrective actions were provided in the coverage.
